methodology: Published primary signals only. Horizon-complete means horizon_end <= evidence_cutoff; resolved metrics exclude no-fill proposals and report that denominator separately. The overlay caps concentration and never promotes a substitute strategy.

policies.caveat: The full three-week snapshot is right-censored. The mature cohort remains negative, but the US-listed-plus-ETF sample is only 16 and strict US is only 15; this supports a concentration cap, not a strategy ban.
policies.clear_only_after: A newer immutable audit with at least 30 mature US/ETF fills across two non-overlapping windows.
